description:
Cross
Yellow Gold Filled Pen and Pencil Set
Vintage American Writing Instruments
This vintage Cross writing set features a matching ballpoint pen and mechanical pencil finished in elegant yellow gold fill. A staple of professional gift-giving and executive stationery for decades, Cross instruments are renowned for their slim profiles, signature conical tops, and reliable twist-action mechanisms. This set represents mid-to-late 20th-century office luxury and comes complete with its original presentation case and accessories.
Classic slim-profile design with yellow gold-filled finish and ribbed linear pattern
Set includes both a twist-action ballpoint pen and a matching mechanical pencil
Original presentation box with brown textured exterior and cream satin lining
Includes genuine leather pen purse with gold-tone rose emblem and instructions
Condition:
Good vintage condition overall. The gold-filled finish shows light surface scratching and minor age-appropriate wear to the polished surfaces. The presentation box remains structurally sound, though there is light fraying to the internal brown fabric securing bands. Both the pen and pencil currently require new ink refills or lead cartridges to be operational.

This lot contains vintage and modern rocks, geodes, marble, and more, suitable for collectors, educational use, or craft projects.

description:
You are purchasing a "Vintage Briar and Corn Cob Tobacco Pipes (3)" in "Used" condition.
Set of three well-worn vintage smoking pipes, perfect for restoration, display, or as characterful decor pieces. Each pipe has its own unique look and texture, giving this trio a lot of visual interest and old-world charm. You’ll receive: - One Dr. Grabow briar pipe with a carved, rustic bowl and curved stem. - One darker rusticated briar pipe with a straight stem and deeply textured bowl. - One classic corn cob style pipe with a straight wooden stem. All three pipes show significant age and use, making them ideal candidates for a cleaning and restoration project or as props and collectibles with authentic patina. Great for collectors, crafters, photographers, or anyone who loves the look of old tobacco pipes. Keywords: vintage pipes, Dr. Grabow pipe, briar pipe lot, corn cob pipe, rustic smoking pipe, pipe restoration, man cave decor, tobacco pipe collection, photo prop
This is a previously owned item being sold AS-IS and have not been tested. Items may have light surface dust/debris and scratches.
Items have varying degrees of wear and residue and may be missing parts.  Expect signs of wear consistent with age.
Condition Notes:
All three pipes show heavy use and age wear. The reddish briar pipe has a rough, carved bowl surface with darkening and buildup inside the bowl, worn finish on the shank, and scuffs and scratches on the curved stem. The darker rusticated briar pipe has a heavily worn, textured bowl with darkening, surface grime along the shank, and a discolored stem with visible wear and small marks. The corn cob style pipe has a yellowed, worn cob bowl with chipping and surface residue, along with a straight wooden stem showing discoloration, small spots, and handling wear. Overall surfaces show scratches, discoloration, and buildup consistent with frequent use and age.

description:
Polished Agate Geode Bookends
Natural Stone with Banded Pattern and Crystalline Druzy
Modern Organic Style, 5.38 lb Set
This pair of bookends is crafted from a single geode, split and polished to reveal the intricate concentric banding characteristic of natural agate. The contrast between the rough, earth-toned exterior and the smooth, luminous interior faces makes these pieces both functional office accessories and striking geological specimens. Naturally occurring druzy quartz crystals are visible in the central cavities, adding a delicate sparkle to the organic forms.
Authentic agate geode cut into a matching pair of bookends
Polished faces showcase grey, tan, and cream concentric banding
Natural rough stone exterior with organic texture
Combined weight of 5.38 lbs for secure support of book collections
Dimensions: 8.5" L x 7.5" W x 6" H
Condition:
Very good condition. Polished surfaces are smooth with excellent clarity and minimal surface wear. The natural stone exteriors are intact with no structural cracks. Bases are flat and provide stable support. No significant chips or damage to the polished rims.

For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.

This striking Septarian nodule, also known as "Dragon Stone," originates from Utah and dates back to the Cretaceous period, approximately 50 to 70 million years ago. The specimen has been professionally cut to reveal a complex interior of honey-yellow calcite crystals and dark brown aragonite veins set against a gray limestone matrix. The distinctive geometric patterns, formed through the drying and cracking of sedimentary clay balls, make each piece a unique work of natural history.

Natural exterior limestone rind provides a rugged, organic contrast to the polished face

description:
Natural Trilobite Fossil
Stone Matrix Specimen
Paleozoic Era
This impressive trilobite fossil is preserved within its natural stone matrix, displaying the characteristic segmented exoskeleton of these ancient marine arthropods. The specimen features a well-defined thoracic region and cephalon, highlighted by a hand-tooled border prepared in the surrounding sedimentary stone to emphasize the fossil's biological form. As a representative of the Paleozoic Era, this piece offers a tangible connection to Earth's prehistoric oceans and early biological diversity.
Natural fossil specimen embedded in sedimentary stone matrix
Detailed thoracic segments and cephalon structure visible on the dorsal surface
Manually prepared border carved into the matrix to highlight the central specimen
Dimensions: 6.5" L x 6" W x 1" H; Weight: 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. The fossil is structurally sound within the matrix with no visible structural repairs or artificial reconstructions. The stone matrix remains solid with natural mineral variations and ochre-toned oxidation consistent with geological aging. The reverse side exhibits natural stone textures and fossiliferous fragments.

Item description terms are as follows:
NEW - The item is New with original packaging and labels or/and factory sealed.
LIKE NEW - The item appears like new and un-used but no longer has a tag and/or original packaging.
GOOD - The item is in a good gently used condition with no major damages or defects
FAIR - The item is in a well-used condition, it may have light scratches or wear and need cleaning. Any major damages will be noted separately.

Natural druzy crystal formation with thousands of small, light-refracting points
Rich coloration ranging from deep crimson to soft blush pink

Natural geologic specimen in excellent display condition. The crystal druzy is largely intact with no significant crushed areas or broad losses. The cut matrix surfaces are smooth with minor natural surface pitting and mineral grain lines characteristic of natural stone. No artificial dyes detected; natural mineral coloration.
